verdict.rationale: Paperspace provides machines/VMs with standard Linux/Windows filesystems, SSH root access, and API/CLI access, which implicitly allows a user to copy data off the platform (e.g., via SSH/SCP or CLI), but there is no explicit documentation of a data export feature, bulk export tooling, or open-format export guarantees for notebooks, datasets, or deployments. missing for 10: explicit data export/portability documentation, open-format guarantees for stored data (notebooks, datasets, models), bulk export tooling, and any first-party statement on data portability or account closure/export process.
